propellant_types.name: Alcohol / LOX
propellant_types.description: Ethanol-water fuel with liquid oxygen. Easy to handle.
propellant_types.source: Inspired by real Redstone-era propellant tanks, 1950s.

propellant_types.name: RP-1 (kerosene) / LOX
propellant_types.description: Dense, storable fuel with cryogenic oxygen. Good first-stage choice.
propellant_types.source: Inspired by real Atlas / Saturn S-IC tanks, 1960s.

propellant_types.name: Hypergolic (storable)
propellant_types.description: Ignites on contact, stores for months, but toxic.
propellant_types.source: Inspired by real Titan II / Apollo service module tanks, 1960s.

propellant_types.name: Liquid hydrogen / LOX
propellant_types.description: Highest efficiency, but LH2 is very low density so tanks are big and heavy.
propellant_types.source: Inspired by real Centaur / Saturn S-IVB tanks, 1960s.

source: Values inspired by real 1960s propellant-tank mass fractions (about 5-8% of propellant mass; hydrogen about 10-12%).
